reviewStatus: Written from public guidance of the organizations listed under Sources. NOT professionally reviewed. See CONTENT_SOURCES.md for per-guide verification dates.
disclaimer: Cairn is educational. It does not replace professional medical care, emergency services, or instructions from local officials.
Conditions vary by location, season and household. Adapt every plan to your situation.
Official emergency instructions (from 911 dispatchers, emergency managers, fire, police, the National Weather Service) always take precedence over this app.
Seek professional medical care when needed. First-aid information here is not a substitute for training; consider a certified first-aid and CPR course.
Review this information and your supplies periodically. Guidance and product recommendations change.

Cairn is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by FEMA, Ready.gov, the American Red Cross, the CDC, the National Weather Service or any other organization it cites as a source.
